title: Enter ripgrep
hints: README → New syntax: `cd` into `$DATA/src` first, then use rg's type flag and its list-files flag.
Three pieces: `cd` (so paths come out relative), restrict to Python files, print only file names.
In a notes folder, `rg -t md -l install` lists the Markdown files that mention `install`.
`cd "$DATA/src" && rg -t ... -l TODO`: find the type name with `rg --type-list | grep -i python`.
